title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left in English, Latin script; not translated]
rarity.mythic: Mythic [English word 'mythic' spelled out in Devanagari, not a Hindi word; players who don't know the English term may not understand it]
shop.buy_robux: Buy for {price} Robux [Robux kept in Latin script inside Devanagari text]
pass.auto_reel: Auto-pull [awkward as a product name: English 'auto' in Devanagari plus a polite command form of 'pull', so it reads like an instruction rather than a name]
pass.lucky_bait: Lucky Bait doubles the chance of catching rare fish! [casual Hinglish: 'lucky', 'rare' and 'chance' are English words written in Devanagari]
sell.prompt: Press E to sell [key letter E in Latin script inside Devanagari text]
ascend.button: Ascend [English word 'ascend' spelled out in Devanagari, not a Hindi word; most Hindi players will not know what it means]
ascend.confirm: Ascend now? You will have to start over, but you will get rare fish {bonus}% more often. ['ascend' is English in Devanagari and likely not understood]
weather.storm: A storm is coming! Rare fish are taking the bait.
quest.title: Missions
quest.catch_n: Catch fish in Moonlight Bay: {n} [unclear whether {n} is the number to catch or a progress count]
afk.kicked: You didn't do anything for too long, so fishing stopped.
daily.streak: A {day}-day streak in a row! Come back tomorrow for more rewards. ['streak' is English in Devanagari and redundant with the Hindi word for 'consecutive' before it]
tip.night: Tip: Some fish only take bait at night.
group.join: Join our community and get 50 free baits! [heavy Hinglish: 'community', 'join' and 'free' are English words in Devanagari; the plural 'chaare' treats bait as countable, slightly odd]
